annotations.description: Configures the production stage to validate releases with the standard semantic version rule `regex_mmp`, enforcing production-ready version formatting [1]. In the unified rule model, stage rules are still expressed as a simple list even though the system now infers rule behavior automatically [2].

refs.heading: Production stage
refs.excerpt:
prod:
      aliases: ["string:stable", "string:latest", "major.minor"]
      rules:
        - regex_mmp         # Standard semver like "1.0.0"

refs.heading: Validation Rules
refs.excerpt: Rules are defined as a flat list. Vertagus automatically detects whether each rule validates a single version (e.g., format checks) or compares versions (e.g., increment checks).
